title: QO-100-modem
short: High speed modem for QO-100 (Es'hail 2) amateur satellite narrow transponder.
desc:
The purpose of this project is to transfer data (pictures...) via a 2.7 kHz SSB channel on the narrow-band transponder as fast as possible. Now includes a RTTY mode.

A characteristic feature of the signal is the presence of a 100 Hz carrier for fine tuning (not visible on the webSDR waterfall).
